related_questions.question: How do I lookup my property taxes in NJ?

text_blocks.snippet: To look up New Jersey property tax information, you can utilize the NJ Property Records website. This site provides a comprehensive property database for New Jersey, allowing you to search by address, neighborhood, city, or ZIP code to find property records, maps, documents, and reports. Alternatively, many municipalities in New Jersey offer online property tax search tools on their own websites. You can also find information on the NJ.gov website, which provides data on property assessments and tax information.

list.snippet: Comprehensive property database with records from 1989 to present.

list.title: How to use:

list.title: Tax List Information:
list.snippet: The information available online is often based on the tax list as certified on January 1st of the tax year.

list.title: Zoning Information:
list.snippet: Zoning information is not always updated on property tax records and may require separate verification from the zoning department.

list.title: Assessed Value vs. Taxes:
list.snippet: Keep in mind that the assessed value is determined by the assessor, while the actual taxes are determined by the tax collector.
